title: OrbitCart
description: AI-assisted e-commerce platform with product discovery and comparison, shopping carts, checkout, order tracking and customer support. Includes role-based admin dashboards for catalog and inventory management, payment monitoring, sales analytics and an operations assistant. Built with React, TypeScript, Spring Boot and MongoDB.
